reviews.text: I have known Sònia and Xavi since 2001 when I brought my first dog, Tro, to them, and I have continued to go with my current dogs, Lola and Havana, despite having moved far from the clinic due to their treatment and professionalism. I have always felt well cared for, listened to and calm with them. I fully trust Sònia's judgment after 25 years of treating my dogs, both directly and by recommending professionals in fields that are not her specialty.

Thank you so much, Antonio, for your review!

We're delighted to hear that your experience at Amazoonia Veterinaris was positive.

Thank you for trusting us, and we hope to see you again soon!
I highly recommend it; we received excellent care, the doctor was very kind, and I will definitely return and recommend it.

Terrible service. To begin with, they gave me an appointment for 12 pm and made me wait 40 minutes in the waiting room without any explanation. I went into the examination room, and the doctor applied an anti-inflammatory and sold me a medication (10 minutes total for the visit) that they had in stock (there were about four boxes). She told me that if my cat recovered, I wouldn't need to use it. The next day, I went back to return the medication since he hadn't needed it; I hadn't opened it. They told me they don't accept returns of medications they have in stock. The total cost was €90 for a 10-minute visit (40-minute wait). And the service was terrible, especially from the person at the counter, who must be the doctor's husband because of his attitude. I don't recommend them; they had zero empathy.
Thank you, Alejandro, for sharing your positive review! We're delighted to hear that your visit to Amazonia was a positive experience. We'd be happy to welcome you back whenever you need us.
Thank you so much, Pedro, for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to hear that your experience at Amazonia was positive. We hope to see you again very soon!
All I can say is thank you; you've been with us for many years.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Lola, and for sharing your experience with Amazonia. We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed our products and that we met your expectations. Best regards!

Excellent customer service. I went in with an emergency for my dog ​​Maya, and the vet saw us as soon as she could. The service was wonderful, and the follow-up was great too. Both my dog ​​and I were very happy.

We are absolutely delighted with Sonia the veterinarian. We have two cats, and she has always treated us with great patience and care. One of our cats has a more challenging temperament, and Sonia always handles her with calm and gentleness, which we truly appreciate. She explains everything clearly so we understand and always provides solutions. I am so grateful to her. I highly recommend her!
Great customer service, very honest.

The receptionist made a mistake. I had made an appointment to vaccinate my cat, and when I arrived, they told me the vaccines hadn't arrived yet. I made the trip for nothing. My cat is very nervous; putting him in the carrier and taking him outside is a bad experience for him.
They told me they didn't have my phone number to contact me, so it's good practice to always ask for it when someone makes an appointment...
A highly recommended veterinary clinic, excellent service, and my pet is calm and happy when she visits.
I highly recommend them!! They were very kind and professional with my dog!!
Sonia is an excellent veterinarian, incredibly dedicated and truly passionate about her work. I would definitely choose her again and again.

The man (Javi) who manages the clinic is absolutely unacceptable. This has happened twice in a row: I arrive for my appointment, he tells me it was 30 minutes ago, and I end up not being seen. The second time, I reconfirm the time with him three times, and again, my dog ​​wasn't seen. It's a shame that Sonia, the veterinarian who is very competent, doesn't have someone professional handling the administration. They are very unreliable; I won't be returning. Oh, and I hope you don't have an emergency, because they won't see you (it's happened to us twice too).

Today we had our first visit to this center with Sonia. They've definitely gained a client. It's a shame we didn't find this place sooner. Our furry friend received a very thorough check-up, done with care and professionalism, something very hard to find these days in this industry.

Thank you so much for the excellent service. I highly recommend this place, and I know what I'm talking about since I've been going to vets for 16 and a half years (my pet's age) and have met quite a few.
With complete confidence. I bring my cat and I am very happy with the treatment and their professionalism.
Thank you so much for your positive feedback, Luis Miguel 😀 and for sharing it. …

Thank you very much for rating and appreciating our service, M. Pilar :)
We are at your disposal, whenever you need us. Greetings!

It's "our" neighborhood clinic. Great care, with a lot of patience. And in the store, you have what you could need.
Both Sònia at the clinic and Xavi at the store are very friendly.
10/10 attention for the furry ones!
Thank you very much for your positive rating, Monica! 🙂 …
The service was amazing, they were very respectful of the appointment scheduling and resolved my issue immediately!! 😊 …
I have nothing but words of gratitude for both Sónia and Xavi. I have known them for many years and they take great care of Rita, Petita and Nori, our two dogs and a cat. I recommend them🐾🐾🐾🫶 …

Impeccable! Today Sonia visited my cat for the first time, and with exquisite professionalism, she gave me a series of explanations aimed at solving his problem. She was a real find for me. Thank you!
A veterinary clinic with impeccable service. They make both pets and clients feel comfortable at all times.

We discovered this vet by chance, and it was the best thing that could have happened to our dog. They accompanied us during Shira's last months and final moments, and the treatment and attention received from Sònia and Xavi was unbeatable in every way. Very grateful.
Perfect as always!!
